key.name: show-cpu-usage
key.description: Show the CPU usage percentage in the panel.

key.name: show-cpu-temp
key.description: Show the CPU package temperature in the panel.

key.name: show-cpu-power
key.description: Show the CPU package power draw in the panel. Needs read access to the RAPL energy counter.

key.name: show-memory-usage
key.description: Show the used memory percentage in the panel.

key.name: show-disk-usage
key.description: Show the used space percentage of the monitored mount point in the panel.

key.name: show-disk-temp
key.description: Show the temperature of the hottest drive in the panel.

key.name: show-disk-io
key.description: Show the combined read and write throughput in the panel.

key.name: disk-mount
key.description: Filesystem whose used space is reported, for example / or /home.

key.name: show-gpu-usage
key.description: Show the GPU usage percentage in the panel.

key.name: show-gpu-vram
key.description: Show the used video memory in GiB in the panel.

key.name: show-gpu-temp
key.description: Show the GPU temperature in the panel.

key.name: show-gpu-power
key.description: Show the GPU power draw in the panel.

key.name: prefix-style
key.description: What identifies each group of panel values: the device icon, a text prefix such as CPU or RAM, or nothing.
